recommendationType: Subjective biomechanical programming estimates, NOT research-measured percentages
interpretation: Fractions summing to 100% represent a relative focus for this specific movement, not percent of muscle activation or fractional hypertrophy.
storageFormat: muscleContributions values are FRACTIONS (0.0 to 1.0), while percentages values are whole percent integers.
upperBackHandling: Use upper_back as separate group; do not silently merge 100% of upper_back into traps.
persistedDataCaveat: Update exercise defaults without rewriting custom/modified exercises or historical snapshots without explicit migration.
